# Data cleanup

Transpose chromatograms. Merge two chromatograms.. Merge metadata and chromatogram.

```{r}
chroma <- read.csv("experiment_csv_09222026.csv", header=T, check.names=F)
md <- read.csv("XO_assay_metadata.csv", header=T, check.names=F)

```

```{r}

#colnames(chroma) <- gsub("RawData - ", "", colnames(chroma))


column_nams <- as.list(colnames(chroma))
```

```{r}
df_long <- pivot_longer(chroma, cols = -Wavelength_nm, names_to = "Filename", values_to = "Absorbance")
print(colnames(df_long))
```

```{r}
df_merged <- left_join(df_long, md[, c("Filename", "La_equivalence")], by = "Filename")

df_merged <- left_join(df_merged, md[, c("Filename", "Sample_Type")], by = "Filename")

df_merged <- left_join(df_merged, md[, c("Filename", "Replicate")], by = "Filename")


```



chromatogram

```{r}
plot_list <- lapply(unique(df_merged$La_equivalence), function(la_eq) {
  
  ggplot(
    subset(df_merged, La_equivalence == la_eq),
    aes(x = Wavelength_nm, 
        y = Absorbance, 
        color = Sample_Type,
        shape = Sample_Type)
  ) +
    geom_point(size = 0.5) +
    
    labs(
      x = "Wavelength (nm)",
      y = "Absorbance (AU)",
      title = paste("La Equivalence:", la_eq)
    ) +
    
    theme_classic() +
    
    theme(
      axis.title.x = element_text(
        family = "sans", size = 16, hjust = 0.5
      ),
      axis.title.y = element_text(
        family = "sans", size = 16, hjust = 0.5
      ),
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        family = "sans", size = 16, color = "black"
      ),
      axis.text.y = element_text(
        family = "sans", size = 16, color = "black"
      ),
      axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 1),
      axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 1),
      axis.ticks.length = unit(.25, "cm"),
      legend.text = element_text(
        size = 14, family = "sans"
      )
    )
})

plot_list[[1]]
plot_list[[2]]
plot_list[[3]]
plot_list[[4]]
plot_list[[5]]
plot_list[[6]]
plot_list[[7]]
plot_list[[8]]

for (i in 1:8) {
  
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0("La_equivalence_", i, ".png"),
    plot = plot_list[[i]],
    width = 8,
    height = 6,
    dpi = 300
  )
}
```

## Max absorbance plot

```{r}


df_max <- data.frame(df_merged)
df_max <- subset(df_max, Wavelength_nm > 574.5)
df_max <- subset(df_max, Wavelength_nm < 575.5)

df_max_summary <- df_max %>%
  group_by(La_equivalence, Sample_Type) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_max_absorbance = mean(Absorbance, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_max_absorbance  = sd(Absorbance, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

```

```{r}
max_abs_plot_combined <- ggplot(df_max_summary, aes(x = La_equivalence, y = avg_max_absorbance, shape=Sample_Type)) + 
  geom_point(size = 3)  +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = avg_max_absorbance - sd_max_absorbance,
                    ymax = avg_max_absorbance + sd_max_absorbance),
                width = 0.05, size = 0.4) + 
  geom_text(aes(label = La_equivalence), vjust = -1)+
  labs(x = "La equivalence",  
       y = "Absorbance at 575nm (AU)") +
theme_classic()+
   theme(axis.title.x = element_text(family = "sans", size = 16, hjust = 0.5),  
        axis.title.y = element_text(family = "sans", size = 16, hjust = 0.5),  
        axis.text.x = element_text(family = "sans", size = 16, color = "black"), 
        axis.text.y = element_text(family = "sans", size = 16, color= "black"),
        axis.line=element_line(size =1),
        axis.ticks=element_line(size=1), 
        axis.ticks.length=unit(.25, "cm"),
        legend.text=element_text(size=14,family="sans"))
plot(max_abs_plot_combined )

ggsave(file="XO_sym_mesobactin_1equivalency_09222026.png", plot=max_abs_plot_combined, width =6, height = 5 )
```

```{r}
write.csv(df_max_summary, "1x_sym_mesobactin_25micromolar_XO.csv", row.names= FALSE)
```
